text:
marta: Quickfire check for tonight's cutline — what's the current blocker picture? any last-minute cherry-picks we should hold?

devon: I brought in one small backport: PR #5421 (fixes memory leak in batching). merged to cutline branch at 2795009200. smoke looks fine locally.

riley: Heads up — canary is showing degraded tail latency after that backport under 95k seq load, investigating.

jamal: marking #5421 as potentially related. I've started a reduced repro on a canary node, will post logs in a bit.

priya: I'm still waiting on review for #5489 (docs + config tweak for batching window). if that's not in, we should still be okay but I wanted the config tweak in case we see pumpy latency.

marta: @riley @jamal please prioritize the repro. if it's not a regression we push ahead at +15. if it is, we gate.

ci-bot: canary-check /report 2795010600 -> failures: 3 flakes, 1 timeout (kvcache-evict test). full: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/7992

riley: attaching snippet of the failing stack: ```
2026-07-12T18:10:12Z ERROR kvcache evict: timeout locking segment id=3
stacktrace: ...
```

jamal: repro shows same eviction timeout but only when batching window > 30ms. rolling back the batching config to 20ms on a canary node removed the timeout.

devon: that matches my local smoke; I can add a quick config rollback to the cutline branch and push a tiny PR if we want to proceed.

marta: do it. open a rollback PR and ping here. if CI passes in 30m we cut.

devon: PR #5498 opened: tiny rollback of batching_window_ms to 20 in cutline. running canary smoke. link: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/5498

ci-bot: canary-check /report 2795011200 -> running smoke (will update).

priya: also FYI I've queued up #5489 for post-cut follow up; no functional risk.

riley: canary smoke green on node A, node B still finishing. tail latency back to baseline on node A.

jamal: node B also green now. all canaries reporting healthy.

marta: thanks — plan: merge rollback PR, proceed with cut at +25. any objections? :thumbsup: 

priya: +1

devon: +1 merging PR now.

ci-bot: merge PR #5498 -> merged at 2795011600 by devon

marta: great work team — I'll kick the cut at +25 and post final rollout link. if anything pops up, ping here first.

riley: leaving a small note in release notes about the batching window rollback and that we'll re-evaluate after telemetry.

marta: perfect. closing thread when cut in prod. :rocket:
